summary: Installs Java and builds the project and Android test artifacts for CI.
author: Codex (external agent)

citations.excerpt:
# The build needs Java 17, set it as the default Java version.
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk
sudo update-alternatives --set java /usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64/bin/java
java -version

# Also clear JAVA_HOME variable so java -version is used instead
export JAVA_HOME=

./gradlew "${GRADLE_FLAGS[@]}" build

# For Firebase Test Lab
./gradlew assembleAndroidTest
./gradlew assembleDebug
